title: 傍晚直壁静线
description: 油画笔触与暖灯下，成人在低直壁上慢慢换重心。

art_direction.medium: linocut print with indigo shadows and ochre highlights
art_direction.scene: Create an original oil-painting illustration of a fictional fully clothed adult moving quietly through a low vertical route under warm evening gym lights. Broad blue jugs form a compact diagonal arrangement, and positive footholds keep both feet just above continuous crash mats. One leg begins to straighten while the other remains engaged, creating a calm natural weight transfer. Use a medium-wide profile composition that includes the whole figure and a generous empty landing area. Paint rich ochre lights, muted indigo shadows, and visible impasto without photographic skin. Background equipment stays far from the mat. The scene is wordless and unbranded, with no leap, dangerous height, or crowd beneath.
